originality.rationale: The 2024 paper proves Gaussian evolution and a single-sinusoid time average, and so already covers the Gaussian closure and one-frequency load. Here the additional, fully quantified four-stationary-point and globally co-optimal-rate bifurcation for a two-harmonic environmental signal requires an independent polynomial-zero count, strict endpoint comparisons and a monotone envelope argument not established by the inspected prior claims. Published related papers address generic periodic mutation selection or different dynamics, not this exact optimizer-topology theorem. Searches cannot guarantee worldwide uniqueness; documented risks remain.
